source_snapshot.test_name_items: Set LAN source in DHCP via BMC
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set LAN source by:
    - IPMI command - Send command: ipmitool lan set <Channel number> ipsrc dhcp.
    - Web UI - Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "Network" -> Check "Use DHCP".
2. Send command: ipmitool lan print to check LAN information.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC LAN should get an IP address from DHCP server.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 ipsrc dhcp 2>&1; echo ---lan-print---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address Source|MAC Address|IP Address" ; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" mc info 2>&1 | grep -i firmware
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: set ch1 LAN source to DHCP then return the FULL `ipmitool lan print` output (IP Address Source, MAC, IP) plus a `mc info` firmware line, so the user confirms the BMC pulled an IP from the DHCP server.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: write to BMC network config (ipsrc dhcp) can drop/re-address the active BMC connection on the managed channel; use a non-management channel and confirm connectivity after.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; relevant command with unsafe channel/credential assumptions.

original_test_intent: Configure the intended BMC LAN channel to DHCP through an authorized BMC interface and prove the lease belongs to the same BMC and remains manageable.
original_method: Use documented IPMI LAN set or WebUI, then read LAN configuration and correlate the assigned address.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies/approves the target channel, DHCP scope and recovery path; no manual action is required for the software core when the IPMI path is used.
required_inputs: Protected credentials and exact BMC identity
safety_requirements: Verify target and alternate management path before the write.
Never hard-code channel 1 or expose credentials.
Do not retry automatically if the address changes unexpectedly.
Preserve old configuration and restore if required.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, set DHCP through the documented channel, rediscover by MAC/lease, reconnect, collect LAN/BMC identity evidence and roll back if planned.
engineer_actions: Approve channel, maintenance window and recovery/rollback.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lan set ... ipsrc dhcp` matches the source, but hard-coded channel 1 and plaintext `-P` credentials are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the platform-selected channel with protected credential input, lease/MAC correlation and alternate OOB recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IPMI or WebUI method, lan print, script and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot current config, set DHCP on the mapped channel, correlate DHCP lease by MAC/client identity, reconnect and verify BMC identity/config, then restore if required.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Mapped BMC LAN channel and DHCP environment.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, ipmitool and DHCP server versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC LAN and DHCP documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity-safe rediscovery, secure credentials and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves the actual network write and lease validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The BMC can become unreachable after readdressing.

project_override_considerations: A project-approved channel, DHCP reservation or duration may vary; record actual plan and do not claim other channels.
expected_evidence: Change response and DHCP lease record
Post-change LAN print and BMC identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: IPMI and WebUI are alternative paths to the same DHCP state; no source contradiction exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Channel, approval and recovery are readiness inputs. The software core is fully automatable under the locked V3.1 capability rule.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the IPMI operation but fixes channel and secret handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to FULLY AUTOMATABLE because approval/input does not reduce software capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates execution readiness, tool result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Adds identity-safe lease correlation and recovery so a changed address is not mistaken for success or device loss.
independent_technical_reasoning: The selected IPMI path can perform the entire configuration, discovery and evidence workflow programmatically; human approval and supplied parameters are gates, not manual core operations.
